content.text: {"summary":"Hidden unit 0 is always off on [-1,1]^3 because its pre-activation is at most about -0.078, so it is unused. I repurposed it as z0 = ReLU(v + 1.5). On the domain this equals v + 1.5, since the argument is always positive. Setting its output weight to -0.2 adds -0.2v - 0.3, and raising b2 by 0.3 cancels the constant. The result is exactly f_old - 0.2v on the intended domain, with everything else unchanged. The estimated_c of about 0.62 is a rough hand estimate, not an exact value. I read the original network's linear damping from its velocity slopes near the origin, which suggests roughly 0.42, then added the new 0.2.","estimated_c":0.62,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[0,0],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[0,1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[0,2],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"b1","index":[0],"value":1.5},{"tensor":"W2","index":[0],"value":-0.2},{"tensor":"b2","index":[0],"value":0.29832287}]}
